company.name: Cube Protocol
company.shortDescription: Cube Protocol is a blockchain-based trust and verification protocol designed for autonomous robotics and AI systems.
company.description: Cube Protocol develops a decentralized trust layer for robotic AI, enabling autonomous machines to operate efficiently while maintaining verifiable and tamper-proof records of their actions. The platform combines off-chain AI computation with on-chain cryptographic proof verification, allowing robots and AI-driven systems to perform high-speed operations without the scalability and cost limitations of traditional blockchain processing. Cube Protocol aims to improve transparency, accountability, and security in robotics, manufacturing, logistics, and AI-powered automation ecosystems by creating auditable and secure machine interactions.
